title: Independent rotation and SVG coordinate derivation
details: For R(a)=[[cos(a),-sin(a)],[sin(a),cos(a)]], R(a)^T R(b)=R(b-a) and R(a)^T R(a)=I. Hence q^T R(a)^T R(b) k depends only on b-a for fixed q,k. Unit vector coordinates at45/135 degrees are +/-1/sqrt(2), +1/sqrt(2). Both shared-rotation frames use80px per unit; component frames use93px per unit. Convert SVG y downward to mathematical y upwards before dot products; figure_verify.py computes actual arrow coordinates rather than trusting displayed labels.
